Markets.title: Dow slumps over 500 pts as Fed minutes revive rate-hike fears
Markets.summary: The Dow dropped over 500 points while the Nasdaq rose following Nvidia's earnings and mixed market performance. Federal Reserve minutes revealed a hawkish stance on inflation and potential interest rate hikes, driving market volatility despite positive holiday forecasts from retailers like Target and TJX.

Markets.title: Fed policymakers focused on inflation risks in October, with some seeing need for bigger rate hike
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve officials kept interest rates steady at their October meeting but discussed a potential half-percentage-point increase due to persistent inflation risks. Policymakers remain concerned that inflation will not ease quickly enough, which may spark intense debates at the upcoming December meeting.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Deepak Fertilisers among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock benchmarks declined due to weak global cues and profit booking. Despite the market drop, analyst Sachin Gupta bullishly recommended Vijaya, Eureka Forbes, and Deepak Fertilisers.

Markets.title: Dalmia Bharat to consider share buyback at Nov 23 board meeting
Markets.summary: Dalmia Bharat announced it will hold a board meeting on November 23 to consider a proposal for sharing a buyback of its equity shares. Specific details regarding the size, price, and number of shares for the buyback have not yet been disclosed.

Markets.title: Target reports strongest quarterly sales gain in five years heading into the holiday shopping season
Markets.summary: Target reported a 7.1 percent increase in third-quarter net sales to $27.07 billion, marking its strongest sales gain in five years. CEO Michael Fiddelke attributed the growth to expanded delivery options, price cuts, and a refreshed product lineup ahead of the holiday season.

Markets.title: Nasdaq gains in choppy trade as Nvidia outlook lifts AI mood; Anthropic pricing awaited
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq rose due to Nvidia's positive revenue guidance, while the Dow Jones and S&P 500 fell due to declines in finance and healthcare stocks. Investors are now awaiting Anthropic's upcoming IPO to gauge market enthusiasm for artificial intelligence ventures.

Geo-Political.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
Geo-Political.summary: BBC journalist Jonathan Beale accompanied Ukrainian forces fighting Russian troops inside an old underground gas pipeline. This subterranean tactic allows Ukrainian soldiers to battle away from the detection of Russian drones.

Geo-Political.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops inside an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region. The BBC reported from this new front line where underground conditions prevent drones from flying.

Geo-Political.title: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres
Geo-Political.summary: Myanmar faces a historic UN court verdict regarding accusations of committing genocide against the Rohingya minority. No state in history has ever been found guilty of genocide by an international court.

Geo-Political.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump, Russian President Putin, and Chinese President Xi will meet for their first three-way summit on Thursday. The leaders shook hands ahead of these historic talks in China.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli military launched a rare ground operation in Gaza beyond the Yellow Line to dismantle a tunnel network. Hamas condemned the incursion as a flagrant ceasefire violation.

Geo-Political.summary: Critics have reviewed Grand Theft Auto 6, concluding that the highly anticipated video game lives up to the immense hype. Reviewers have praised the title as a masterpiece.

Data & Insights.summary: India imported 5.83 million tonnes of soybean oil during the 2025-26 period. This accounted for a rising share of the country's total edible oil imports of 16.92 million tonnes.

India.title: From Kala Pani To A New Prison Policy: Andaman-Nicobar To Scrap 130-Year-Old Prisons Act
India.summary: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are replacing the 130-year-old Prisons Act with the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Prisons and Correctional Services Regulation, 2026. This new policy aims to reform local prison administration and move away from the colonial-era penal system.

India.title: Woman's Body Found In Garbage Pile In Uttarakhand: Cops
India.summary: Police in Uttarakhand found a woman's body in a garbage pile. Investigators believe she was murdered at another location and her body was dumped there to hide the crime.

India.title: Baby Separated From Parents After Kaziranga Crash Reunited With Family
India.summary: An infant separated from its parents following a car crash in Kaziranga, Assam, has been safely reunited with them. The baby had been receiving care from medical staff while the parents were treated for critical injuries sustained in the accident.

India.title: 8-Car Convoy Of Liquor Smugglers Try To Mow Down Police Team In Gujarat
India.summary: An eight-car convoy of liquor smugglers attempted to run over a police team in Gujarat during a chaotic escape. The speeding vehicles severely injured a cow on the road before crossing the border into Methipura, Rajasthan.
